parameters.content: SF8b v-next - Approval Write-Back (F32). Reads the v-next Sheet COPY, validates the run_id/company_id/Decision/Note headers (missing header = zero writes + Gmail draft naming it), applies only rows whose run_id matches the expected run, keys decisions by run_id|company_id, and skips decisions already recorded with the same note (skipped_duplicate).

parameters.query: SELECT company_id::text AS company_id, decision, COALESCE(note, '') AS note FROM approvals

WITH items AS (SELECT x FROM jsonb_array_elements($1::jsonb) AS x)
INSERT INTO approvals (company_id, decision, decided_by, note)
SELECT (x->>'company_id')::uuid, x->>'decision', $2, NULLIF(x->>'note','')
FROM items x
WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM approvals a WHERE a.company_id = (x->>'company_id')::uuid AND a.decision = x->>'decision')
RETURNING company_id

WITH items AS (SELECT x FROM jsonb_array_elements($1::jsonb) AS x)
UPDATE companies c
SET status = CASE WHEN x->>'decision' = 'approved' THEN 'approved' WHEN x->>'decision' = 'rejected' THEN 'rejected' ELSE c.status END
FROM items x
WHERE c.id = (x->>'company_id')::uuid AND x->>'decision' IN ('approved','rejected')
RETURNING c.id
